metadata.status: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; LEGACY BEHAVIOR, NOT APPROVED DESIGN
metadata.baseline: soulsbo-main-updated.zip; runtime source preserved from supplied handoff baseline
metadata.method: Synthetic fixtures invoking sistemas.gwent identity handlers, aplicar_jogada, _aplicar_combo_de_cartas, _poder_efetivo and _remover_unidade; no database, HTTP, Discord, browser or production match used.

cases.reason: the 8-power unit falls below the 6-power unit after Geada and current-row weather

cases.finding: purification clears statuses and grants buffs; it neither consumes nor depends on shield
team_bonus selection reads current row; original fileira does not exclude a moved ally
movement changes current-row targeting but does not rewrite the player's last played row
Blood Price uses effective power, then sacrifice bypasses shield and central removal clears statuses
Vengeance is downstream of successful removal, not a failed attempt
team_bonus is scoped to pre-existing allies on the played card's current row

limits: Assertions cover selected cross-interactions and do not exhaust all 54 candidate effect families, identities, combos, leaders or rarities.
Results describe current legacy behavior only; they do not approve retaining the same behavior in the rebuilt engine.
No full competitive simulation, HTTP dispatch, production database, Discord runtime or browser interaction was performed.
The audit does not settle BUF-001 through BUF-014; it adds evidence for interaction boundaries and target-selection dependencies.
